theme_strategy.description: High contrast financial app designed for high clarity and fast mobile transaction logging in printing and branding SMBs in Indonesia.

font_rules.h1: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
font_rules.card_title: text-sm sm:text-base font-semibold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider
font_rules.currency_large: font-mono font-bold text-2xl sm:text-3xl tracking-tight text-slate-900

layout_and_spacing.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-6
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6
layout_and_spacing.mobile_fab_cta: fixed bottom-5 right-5 z-50 shadow-2xl rounded-full bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white p-4 flex items-center gap-2 transition-all transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 md:hidden

fixed_costs_banner.summary: Biaya Tetap Bulanan: KUR Rp1.600.000 + Internet Rp400.000 + Listrik Rp400.000 + Operasional Rp750.000 (Total Rp3.150.000)
fixed_costs_banner.badge_style: px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-md border

key_components.quick_add_transaction_modal: Shadcn Dialog component customized for quick mobile touch entry with predefined printing expense categories (Bahan Baku, Cetak Outdoor/Indoor, Offset, Konveksi, Operasional, KUR, Internet/Listrik)
key_components.receivables_payables_cards: Visual distinction between Piutang (Receivables - Emerald/Teal tint) & Utang (Payables - Rose/Amber tint) with one-click 'Tandai Lunas' action button
key_components.profit_loss_sharing_breakdown: 50% Pemilik : 50% Pengelola distribution with Rp0 protection fallback when month is net loss, plus 'Tandai Sudah Dibagi' status toggle

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all currency outputs are consistently formatted as 'Rp1.500.000' (Indonesian dot separator).
Implement 4 clear tab views: 1) Buku Kas Harian, 2) Rekap Bulanan, 3) Laba Rugi & Bagi Hasil, 4) Piutang & Utang.
Dashboard summary header must display live cards: Saldo Kas Saat Ini, Laba Bulan Berjalan, Total Piutang Belum Lunas, and Total Utang Belum Lunas.
Maintain mobile responsiveness with floating bottom quick action button for fast daily transaction entry.
Support CSV Export/Import and JSON Backup/Restore for offline data portability.
Always apply data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-transaction-btn', data-testid='kas-table', data-testid='profit-share-card') to interactive and key display elements.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_ratio: APCA AA standard verified. Green badges use dark green text (#047857) over light green bg (#ECFDF5). Red badges use dark red text (#B91C1C) over light red bg (#FEF2F2).
accessibility_and_testing.touch_targets: Minimum 44px x 44px for touch elements on mobile screens
